meta_description: Architecture, security posture and compliance evidence for BI & Analytics Platform — Digital Twin & IoT Intelligence Platform from Achala IT Solutions.

blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of BI & Analytics Platform — Architecture & Trust: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (retrofit telemetry with data contracts, physics+data models with validation regime, KubeEdge-class orchestration with OTA); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (RUL models into CMMS scheduling, what-if and capacity simulation); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

blocks.title: BI & Analytics Platform — plane and service layers
blocks.note: Ownership maps to layers: one team per stratum, contracts at the interfaces, no shared blind spots.

blocks.title: BI & Analytics Platform — deployment topology and flow
blocks.note: Edge nodes ship with the same controls as the core — identity, monitoring and rollback — because a branch office is not a demilitarized zone.

blocks.x: Twinverse runs IEC 62443-aligned segmentation for industrial estates, hardware roots of trust and signed boot on edge fleets, and privacy governance (face blurring, retention) for camera systems. Telemetry carries contracts — units, timestamps and lineage are trustworthy by construction.

items: The control estate mapped to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 criteria, evidence produced continuously.
Sector rules translated into controls per jurisdiction — the mapping is data, reviewed when the regime moves.
AI-specific obligations mapped to controls — model risk, transparency and human oversight, owned by name.

blocks.x: Every claim about BI & Analytics Platform — Architecture & Trust lives inside a measured envelope — what it holds at load, where it degrades first, and what the rollback path costs.
The program dashboard tracks these by default, wired to your channels:

items: Freshness attainment published per dataset — data age is uptime, treated the same way.
Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.
Spend per query attributed to the team that wrote it — the meter everyone can see.
Deployed inside your tenancy, your keys, your logs — the default for regulated estates.
Operated by us under contract — SLOs published, changes gated, your auditors given a walkthrough path.
Split by design: what must stay local stays local, what benefits from scale scales.

blocks.x: BI & Analytics Platform — Architecture & Trust runs on the same delivery standard as the rest of the portfolio: measure first, gate honestly, and let the evidence decide what scales.

items: Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
Workloads land on the cheapest compute that still meets the latency budget.

blocks.x: Walk the architecture with the platform team — a working session that includes the evidence trail your auditors would test.
